A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions

Where should we start?+

Choose one repeatable task and assemble representative inputs. Define what a useful output looks like before comparing models.

What should we measure?+

Measure task completion and output quality alongside latency and cost. Review failure cases and decide when a person should approve the output.
